pretreatment: Deposited at a high temperature of 300°C and followed by postdeposition rapid thermal annealing at 800°C
evidence: Depositing ZnO on glass substrates as an active layer for transparent thin film transistors was widely studied. However, there are only few papers on the ZnO photonic devices grown on glass substrates because of the poor crystallinity due to the lack of epitaxy of ZnO with amorphous glass substrates. In this paper, we present the ALD of ZnO films on the Corning 1737 glass substrate, which is an amorphous alkaline earth boro-aluminosilicate.
